Lately, I’ve been feeling mentally exhausted by the constant flow of information. From the moment I wake up, I check my phone, see notifications, news, messages, social media, videos, and opinions about everything. Even when I turn on the television, it feels like there is always something urgent, negative, or demanding my attention.

I’ve started wondering whether we are actually giving our minds enough time to rest. Sometimes I pick up my phone without even knowing why, and twenty minutes later I feel more tired than before. It is useful for work, communication, learning, and entertainment, but it also feels like it is slowly taking away our ability to be bored, quiet, or fully present.

Does anyone else feel psychologically tired because of information overload? Have you found any practical ways to slow down without completely disconnecting from the world? Do you limit screen time, turn off notifications, avoid the news, or have phone-free periods during the day?

At this point, do you think the smartphone is our greatest friend, our greatest enemy, or simply a tool we have not learned to control yet?
